brief: A compact app launcher for the Galaxy Z Flip3 cover screen. Bright, simple, recognisable without a letter inside.

concepts.name: Glance
concepts.idea: A small app window beside two cameras identifies the cover screen at a glance.
rationale: White frame and yellow display on a bright blue tile
A compact monochrome cut keeps the idea readable at 16 px
Original path lettering and native Android adaptive vectors

next_steps: Android adaptive and themed icons integrated
Use the small-size cut below 32 px
